tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (161)༄༅/ /dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas mnan pa'i las rim ri rab nag po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /(162)dus mtha'i me ltar rab 'bar rta mcho
(161)༄༅/ /dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas mnan pa'i las rim ri rab nag po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /(162)dus mtha'i me ltar rab 'bar rta mcho

tei:div.tei:p: (161)༄༅// dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas mnan pa'i las rim ri rab nag po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (162)

dus mtha'i me ltar rab 'bar rta mchog dpal// 'chol ba'i khro rgyal chen po'i dmod pa'i thog /log 'drenadagra bgegs snying la 'bebs pa'i slad// mnan pa'i las rim ri rab nag po spro// de la 'dir dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas las kyi mtha' sdud mnan pa'i phrin las bya ba la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis gtan la 'bebs te/ de yang sngon 'gro bcas bshams kyi rim pa logs su 'chad pa las shes par byas nas/ dngos gzhi (cho ga'i )gzhung la 'jug pa ni/ ji skad du/ dang po sngags pa bsnyen pa rdzogs pa yis: zhes dang*/ rgyud bzhi dbang thob dam tshig dang ldan pas: zhes gsungs pas/ de'ang yi dam (163) 'di'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum chad du 'khyol ba'am/ min na'ang yi dam gang rung la bsnyen pa them zhing*/ 'di ni dbang lung man ngag nod pa'i sngags pas drag po'i las la shis pa'i gnas su/ dmar phyogs kyi gza' tshes dus sbyor shin tu rtsub cing bdud nyi dang nyi nag la phung gsum lcags khams kyi lo zla nyi khyim sogs spyi tsam dang*/ byai brag dmigs bya'i lo zla zhag dus kyi log sbyor rtsub mos dgra bor khyim shang gnad du phrad pa'i dus tshad de/ gang gi cha na'ang snying rje khros pa'i zhe sdang ldog tu med pa'i gnas skabs su brtsam dgos pa ni/ ji skad du/ zhe sdang ma yal mthu yi mchog /ces pa bzhin bshad ma (164) thag pa'i stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi ngang las ldang ba'i gnad ma shes na mngon pa'i nga rgyal che ba tsam la dgos pa med de/ gter khyim du/ lta ba rtogs shing snying rje bsgral ba bces: zhe sdang rang mthu srin po'i mthu: phyi ma ngan song du lhung ngo*// zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don yang blo la ma chud na/ sngags 'chang mthu skad can la'ang las 'bras kyi rnam smin dang*/ phyi ma'i phebs lam spyi mthun nyag gcig tu gyur pa'ang bsams nas/ bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa'i bar sngon du grub rjes/

thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo: bde chen chos dbyings sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sku: sogs gzhung ltar dang*/ spro na/ hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings las rang byung grub pa'i lha: dbang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: 'chol ba'i (165)khro rgyal chen po 'khor dang bcas: dpal chen yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrinalas mdzod: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang : gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs rdzogs mdzad pa: phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs zhi khro dang : dbang drag pad+ma'i lha tshogs thugs dam can: mi mngon dbyings nas 'dir gsheg thugs dam bskul: drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la babs: thugs dam thugs rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: zhes bskul lo/ de nas gser skyems bshams la/ rig 'dzin (166) rtsa brgyud ma'i 'phros dkar nag bden rdzun gi shan 'byed mkhyen gsol ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang nas bzung ste: dpal mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chod du: sangs rgyas dngos dang snyan brgyud ma chad pa'i: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin brda brgyud dang : gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma snyan gson cig: gsang sngags bla med dgongs pa snying po'i don: 'khor 'das byang chub sems su ro gcig pas: 'od gsal thig le chen po'i ngang nyid las: rigs can rnams kyis smin grol byed pa la: dam nyams zhing bcu rnams (167)kyis ma ster ro: rig 'dzin bla mas gzu dang dpang mdzod cig: dbyings dang ye shes dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag: rigs lnga rigs gsum dus gsum rgyal dang sras: yon tan phrin las ma lus 'dus pa'i sku: zhi khro rab 'byams sgrub pa bka' brgyad dang : rdo rje gro lod bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i lha: las dang ye shes mkha' 'gro snyan gson cig: bla ma mchog mjal dbang bskur man ngag zhus: rgyud sde'i dgongs pa bskyed rdzogs zab mo bsten: bde gshegs bka' bzhin bsgrub sems rnal 'byor (168)bdag:

bstan pa'i dgra bo 'di yis sems dkrugs so: yi dam lha tshogs gzu dang dpang mdzod cig: kun tu bzang mo spyan dang mā ma ki: gos dkar sgrol ma rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro ma: gnas dang yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang : sprul dang yang sprul ma sring rgya mtsho dang : dur khrod brgyad kyi mkha' 'gro snyan gson cig: bas mtha' nags 'dabs gnas dang dur khrod du: lhag pa'i sems la sbyor ba'i brtul zhugs kyis: zhi gnas lhag mthong nyams rtogs sgom pa la: phung byed dam nyams 'di yis ma ster ro:(169)sngags srung dam can rgya mtsho dregs pa'i tshogs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gros gzu dang dpang mdzod cig: chos longs sprul skus stong dang rten cing 'brel: zung 'jug rgyu 'bras 'das pa'i chos bstan pa: gdul bya'i bsags pas theg pa grub mtha'i sgo: mtha' yas du mar go yang ngo bo gcig: kun la ris med dag snang rtsal sbyangs shing : bdag bstod gzhan smod chags sdang tsher ma spang : rang gis tshul bzhin dam chos spyod sems la: ban dgra bon dgra nag po'i 'tshe ba dang : rang zas sman la gzhan (170)zas dug ltar bltas: dman pa'i sa bzung kha nan dpung pa smad: mtho la ma smad dma' la ma brnyas shing : bar du phrag dog ru nga'i sbyor spangs kyang : bstan pa'i ru tra nag po glang snying 'dis: spyir ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yongs la 'tshe: sgos su dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rgyud sprugs: yang sgos bdag cag chos srid bcas pa la: bden pa khyad gsod rang gnong khong bsran bcas: ngor rtsub ma bde thabs kyis mtha' nas bskul: rang nus ma thon log 'dren gzhan dag rbod: kha dkar zhe gnag mgo smod rgab nas (171)rtsub: ma byas byas dang ma byung byung zhes pa'i: legs bsrubs nyes sgrogs ya ga ngan smras sbyor: rgyab nas 'ded cing mdun nas bsgug pa dang : zur nas gsod gcod brku 'phrog brdeg byed cing : rang gi chos srid 'byor pas mi ngoms par:

gzhan la phrag dog bstan la bsnyings pa yi: phyi dgra zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba dang : nang dgra bsam ngan rlung ltar 'tshubs pa yi: snga dgra nyes byed chu ltar rgyug pa dang : phyi dgra byed bsam dug ltar khong nas g.yo: da dgra drag po tsher ltar rtsub pa yi: byad ma dgra bo (172)phyogs mtshams gar gnas kyang : 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das tshul 'dzin pa'i: bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho dregs pa'i 'khor: bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnal 'byor la gdungs pa'i: rngams draga'abar ba dpal gyi pho nya rnams: rgyal ba'i bka' dang rnal 'byor dam bzhin 'dus: nyes byed dgra bo'i gzugs phung rnam shes bcas: pha tshan yul 'khor mi nor sde dpung rnams: rang dbang med par drag po'i rten la phob: ces gser skyems gshegs shing*/ spros pa chung skabs gzhung gi gzu dpang gis kyang 'thus so/ brub khang bskyed pa ni/ e: bdag nyid che (173)mchog pad+mar gsal ba yi: thugs nas mthing nag e yig chad pa las: yongs gyur gnod byed dgra bgegs brub pa'i khung : gnam lcags las grub btson khang zur gsum pa: zin nas thar ba med pa mun pa'i gling : steng nas 'dab chags sha zan klad na lding : 'og phyogs 'dod chags khrag mtsho dba' rlabs 'khrugs: nang dmar zhe sdang rang bzhin me dpung 'bar: phyi nag gti mug mun pa sprin ltar gtibs: khor yug lcags sreg pa gzhir bshan pa'i grong : rtsang dmar (174)las byed gshin rje'i pho nya'i tshogs: nyi shu rtsa gcig 'khor bcas gsal bar gyur: ces brub khang pho nya dang bcas gsal btab nas/ dmigs bya gsal 'debs pa ni/ nṛ tri: de nang bkod pa'i liṅga bsgral ba'i zhing : bstan pa spyi dang rnal 'byor sgos kyi dgra: dam nyams gnod byed dgra bgegs a mu ka: gzugs brnyan ri mor bris la ming byang btab: rnam shes rten dang bcas la zag rdzas byugs: nyam thag bya ngan 'dug stangs rkang lag bcings: mngon sum lta bur gsal ba nyid du gyur:

ces dngos su bsam/ de nas 'gugs 'dren bya ba ni/ na mo: rtsa brgyud bla ma (175)rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dam can srung mar bcas: sngags 'chang bdag gi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin: dkon mchog gsum sogs bka' yi bden pa dang : khyad par dbang chen rdo rje gro bo lod: las kyi mtha' sdud 'chi bdag ma he'i gdong : bla 'gugs mon pa pho mo sprul 'khor bcas: dbang drag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus: bla ma'i sku dgra bstan dang bstan 'dzin dmod: khyad par sngags 'chang bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag: rgyu sbyor bsrung bya mi nor 'khor bcas la: snga dgra lag (176)brdar phyi dgra yid la sems: da dgra gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegs: dur sri gung sri god sri chung sri dang : pho sri mo sri tshon sri dgra sri sogs: kha 'jam gting rtsub zhe nas dmod pa dang : do bsdo phod 'dzugs bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byed: mi la lha med lha la mthu med ces: mthu dang nus pa bu lon bzhin du gsher: 'gro lam rtsang 'jug za lam dug sbyor bshams: dmigs yul gzugs ling bkod pa 'di rnams kyi: rnam shes bla tshe srog dang bcas pa rnams: gnam sa gling bzhi gling phran ri rab seng : nyi zla'i (177)go bar chos bon srung ma'i skyabs: gang na gnas kyang liṅga 'di nyid la: khug cig badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza: rked nas chings shig badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: yan lag sdoms shig badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: myos par gyis shig badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho: lha dang phyes shig pra we sha ya phaṭa: dbyer med stims shig ā be sha ya ā: zhes 'gugs 'ching sdom myos dbyer bstim gyi phyag rgya dang dmigs gnad nan tan bskyed de 'gugs gzhug rol mo'i mtshams rngams shugs sgra dang bcas bya/ slar yang gzhung gi 'gugs pa brgya 'am nyer gcig gam bdun la sogs dngos nyams dang sbyar zhing gu gul nag pos bdug pho nya bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: bskal pa (178)chen po brgyad khri yi:

bzhi stong 'khor ba'i gzhal yas nas: lcags mkhar sgo med bcu drug gi: 'bar ba'i dbus phyogs rngams pa nas: 'obs chen bcu gnyis gting mtha' med: thod mkhar 'bar ba'i nag zhig na: pho brang lcags mkhar spu gris gtams: klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong : lto phye phyogs skyong ma he'i khri: thabs shes nyi zla'i gdan steng nas: srog bdud tshe bdag nag po bzhengs: rngams pa'i tshul gyis bla 'gugs rnams: da lta khyed kyi las la khye: dzaḥ shar gyi phyogs nas bla 'gugs (179)pa: dung gi mon pa seng ge'i mgo: lho yi phyogs nas bla 'gugs pa: lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo: nub kyi phyogs nas bla 'gugs pa: bse yi mon pa dred kyi mgo: byang gi phyogs nas bla 'gugs pa: gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo: bla rkun mon pa khyed bzhi yang : dbu dgu spyan dgu zhal dgu gdangs: phyag dgu zhabs dgu tsit+ta dgu: zhabs dgus stong gsum bla la rgyug: spyan dgus dgra bgegs bltas nas 'dzin: snying dgus dgra bgegs yid la byed: phyag dgus dgra (180)bgegs tsit+ta 'byin: zhal dgus kha mngar med par gsol: ljags dgus myos pa'i khrag mtsho 'thung : dgra bgegs myur du khrid la shog: dzaḥ shar phyogs dri za me lha'i gtso: he le khyab pa gtum chen 'joms: dgra bgegs srog dbugs rdul du rlogs: dzaḥ lho phyogs gshin rje srin po'i gtso: nag po 'jum med gtum chen 'jom: dgra bgegs srog dbugs rdul du rlogs: dzaḥ nub phyogs chu dbang rlung lha'i gtso: nag po bkrag med chags med 'jom: dgra bgegs srog dbugs rdul du rlogs: (181)dzaḥ byang phyogs gnod sbyin 'byung po'i gtso: so 'dar 'khrig pa khrag chen pos: dgra bgegs srog dbugs rdul du rlogs: bh+yo: dpal gyi phyag brnyan rak+ta'i dri bsnams ma: khrag mdog dmar po bse yi ral pa can: sder mo lcags kyu'i rtse la rak+ta'i me 'bar ma: nyams pa'i snying phyung mchan khung chug la shog:

khros pa'i zhal mdog khrag gi mchin pa kha: rgyug pa'i stabs ni spyang mo ngar ma 'dra: drag po'i skad ni nam mkha'i 'brug las che: rgyug pa'i stobs ni bar snang glog las mgyogs: zangs (182) kyi sdai+er mo dmar mo'i changs pa ru: mgon med byi phrug sha rjen bcug pa ltar: dam nyams dgra bo'i don snying phyung la shog: rnam smin phung po dum bur gtubs la shog: gzugs kyi phung po de ru zhog la shog: rnam par shes pa 'di ru khyer la shog: dgra bgegs gnod byed aṅku sha ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes rol mo'i tsham rngams kyis drag tu bskul la g.yab dar g.yob cing 'od zer 'phro 'du dang pho nyas bkug bla 'gugs kyi sngags ni/ hūm̐ badz+ra shrī gro bo lod dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nṛ tri aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ bla sha re ma ti 'grim 'grim: sha ma ru ti thuṃ thuṃ: myog myog: yed (183)yed: sha ma ru ti khug khug: ling myogs: ling shag: ling thuṃ: tsa mun+t+ri dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: zhes gzhung las 'byung ba dang*/ nṛ sha ku ru: nṛ sha ku ruḥ kha so pa ti: kha so pa ti: yaṃ ru ti: yaṃ sai na yaṃ se na: me na yaṃ: snying tshal par rbad: baṃ ri li rbad: dam nyams dgra bgegs khyed kyi bla rten tshe rten srog rten ci yod pa thams cad 'dir khug myur du shog cig: ces bla khug pa'i rtags ma byung bar du bzla'o// gal te khug pa'i mtshan ma shin tu bul na/ dmigs pa drag tu gzhur zhing bla 'gugs kyi pho nya mo mon mo'i tshogs dang khyi 'gyed sogs rbad pas mod la khug pa ni/ (184) ji skad du/ las kyi pho nya 'di dag ni// bskul dang rbad pas srid gsum 'joms// las bsgrub the tshom med pa'i nges// zhes gsungs kyang 'dir re zhig de tsam mo/ de yang dus gnad ni/ dmigs bya rang rang la bla rgyu dus mi 'dra ba re re sogs zab gnad mang du gsungs kyang 'dir rgyas bshad dor ba'i/ ji skad du/ snga dro stag mo langs pa'i dus dag ni: nyin gung khyim bya gdang la nyal ba dang :

srod la srin mo lto la rngub pa'i dus: khyad par nyi ma grib so 'jug dus dang : zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don gtso bor bzung nas/ tho rengs/ gung gnyis shar nub kyi grib so byung skabs/ srod gdong nag dus te drug go /rgyas bsdus kyi go skabs rig pa'i mda' mo 'phangs par bya'o// skabs su rigs mthun gyi gzhung gzhan las byung ba'i zab gnad 'di yang bya ste: hūm̐ bh+yo: da ni bsgral ba'i thugs dam dus la (185)bab: da ni nam gyi srod la bab dus 'dir: chom rkun las la 'gyed pa'i dus yin pas: dam nyams dgra bo'i bla tshe 'khyams pa'i dus: dam nyams dgra bo'i bla 'khyams khug la shog: bh+yoḥ da lta nam gyi gung la bab dus 'dir: sems med 'byung ba chu yang gnyid log gi: dgra bo las ngan sdig can gnyid log gi: bla tshe 'khyams po da lta khrid la shog: bh+yo: da lta nam gyi tho rangs bab dus 'dir: dgra bo'i bla tshe 'phyo zhing 'phro ba'i dus: dam nyams dgra bo'i bla tshe 'phyo ba'i (186)dus: las ngan bla 'khyams myur du khrid la shog: bh+yo: da ni nam langs nyi ma shar dus 'dir: mi phyugs thams cad las la gram pa'i dus: dgra bo'i bla tshe sgo ru thon pa'i dus: bla 'khyams las ngan myur du khrid la shog: bh+yo: da lta nyi ma'i gung la bab dus 'dir: dgra bo'i rnam shes dbyings shi myos pa'i dus: dgra bo'i bla tshe 'thom zhing 'khyams pa'i dus: bla 'khyams las ngan myur du khrid la shog: bh+yo: da ni nyi nub grib so phog pa'i dus: snying mi dga' zhing shes pa 'phyo ba'i dus: dgra bo'i bla tshe rnam shes 'phyo ba'i dus: bla 'khyams las ngan (187)myur du khrid la shog:

ces dang rang rang gi dus dang bstun pa'i bskul ba'am yang na mthar chags su bya'o// de nas rgyab rten gyi lha dang dbral ba ni/ gu gul gyis bdug bya rog dang 'ug pa'i dang sgro gnyis kyis g.yab cing*/ spro na dgra bo'i lha lnga ming rus dang bcas pa'i bar du ma mo'i sngags byang btem la sgro yis gnon zhing dbye rdzas dmigs bsal gyis bdug pa dang*/ bskul byang sogs gud las byung ba ltar 'dir yang sems so// hūm̐ sdig can dgra bo las ngan 'di: dgra lha spyi bo'i gtsug nas phrol: srog lha snying gi dkyil nas phrolaḥ zhang lha lte ba'i khung nas phrol: ma lha gsang ba'i gnas nas phrol: pho lha phrag pa g.yas nas phrol: mo lha phrag pa g.yon nas phrol: (188)bang lha mdzod khang nang nas phrol: ban bon la sogs 'go ba'i lha: rig 'dzin la sogs srung ba'i lha: ma lus rgyab nas phrol nas shog: hūm̐ las byed pho nya thams cad dang : bdag gi srung ma dam can rnams: dgra bo'i lha lnga dbang du sdus: dgra bo'i yul lha mnol du chug: dgra bo'i pho lha gyes su chug: dgra lha pham zhing 'thor du chug: ma lha ma sman yar du chug: dgra bo lha dang phrol la shog: bdag gi grogs byed dam can rnams: nyes byas dam nyams dgra bo 'di: mgon byed yul lha dbang du sdus: mtshon byed pho lha dbang du (189)sdus: skyob byed dgra lha dbang du sdus: grogs byed ma lha dbang du sdus: srung byed srog lha dbang du sdus: le gu'i lha srung byad du phob: phan byed zhang lha dbang du sdus: hūm̐: kha kha mu kha mthu mo che: mthing nag chen mo bya rog dbu: rtog med zad su sha la za: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: hu lu mu kha mthu mo che: ser nag chen po 'ug pa'i dbu: khyod ni nyin mtshan med par rgyug: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: dgra dang dgra lha phrol la shog: lus dag srung ma phrol la shog: khye dang chung ma phrol la shog:(190)gnyen dang nye du phrol la shog:

phu bo nu bo phrol la shog: mngon spyod drag pos rdul du rlog: a nṛ tri trag rak+sha ma ra ya phye phye: ma ma trag rū tra mā ra ya phye: zhes bag chom re bzlas pas lha dbye'o// pha rol po lha srung bzang na lha lnga dkrog pa'i drag sngags gzhung las 'byung ba ltar bya'o// de nas dngos nyams rmi lam gyi sgo nas bla rtags mthong ba dang*/ de nyid gang du brdzu ba der mngag pa'i pho nya rbad dgos pa'o// re zhig 'dir ma spros pas bstan don gal che'i rigs la logs su shes par bya'o// de ltar zhag grangs ji ltar yang khug pa'i rtags mthong na bsad pa'i las la 'jug dgos te/ slob dpon chen pos/ bla ma khug par las la sbyor ba ni dgra bo mod par mtshon cha rtog pa dang 'dra: bla khug nas las la ma sbyar na bskung par nas dgra bo sher ba dang 'dra: zhes (191) sogs skyon yon gyi rnam grangs shin tu mang bar gsungs bar bsad pa'i las la sbyar ba ni/ thun snod g.yag rgod kyi rwa g.yas me chu ma phog pa'i nang du thun rdzas rnams tshang ba shog gu'am g.yag rngas bkab mdun du bshams la/ e dzaḥbh+yo: thun snod nad mtshon dug rlangs khol ba'i klong : thun rdzas las byed pho nya za gsod rngams: gtum drag rgyob sod 'jigs pa'i 'brug stong ldir: stong khams gang ba'i mtshon cha thog ltar 'bebs: log 'dren gnad la dbab pa'i mthu ldan gyur: ces gzi byin bskyed la/ dmigs gnad ni/ drag sngags mtshon cha'i 'od zer las: shugs ldan rin chen nyil ltar 'phros: sha za gsod byed pho nya bskul: kho yi ba spu bu (192) gar gdab: sogs gnam lcags 'khor lo bsnol ma shugs drag tu bskor dmigs kyis rang gshed rang la dbab pa'i dmigs gnad zab mo zhal las shes par byas nas bzla ba'i sngags ni: rtsa sngags sham du/ oṃ āḥ.uṣ+ṇi ṣa ya rbad: yan+t+ra tsak+t+ra rbad: man tra ya tsa ma rbad: zhes dang*/ zab gnad tshe na rtsa sngags gsham du gzhung gi dam sri shi sa bsnan pa'i sngags snod kyang bzla zhing mchil rlang sam shor ba'i gnad dang ldan pas thun la ngar blud nas 'di ga la thun gyis brab cing bskul ba ni:

hūm̐: nga ni rdo rje gro bo lod: dgra dang bgegs kyi gnyen po ste: yungs kar rgyal po sha ri raṃ: dgra bgegs steng du brab par bya: khrag thun dug rlangs chi li li: mtshe dpal mda' 'phen zangs se zang : (193)gnam lcags thog chen hri li li: yungs kar rbab 'dril sha ra ra : phung po'i steng du brab par bya: dza mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dgra bgegs kyi srog rtsa la trig nan: e hur thuṃ dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad sod: ces dang*/ spro na gzhung gi drang srong dmod pa dang : 'go nas 'byung ba'i/ lo dang zla ba la sogs kyang brjod/ de nas bsad rtags kyi drod tshod shes par bya dgos te/ snga ma'i 'phro las/ gsod pa'i nang rtags med par mnan bsreg 'phangs gsum byas na dgra mi 'chi'o// zhes dang*/ bsad las tshad las thal na rang nyid grir 'chi: dod tshad las mkhas na mda' dang 'dra'o: zhes sungs pas so// de phyir sod rtags mngon du gyur nas/ mnan pa'i las sgrub pa ni/ gzhung gzhan las/ gnas lnga gnam lcags tsakra (194) ni: bcibs bzhi sra zhing lci ba res: bsgul bskyod mi nus mnan par bsgom: zhes gsungs pas/ dmigs pa gsal 'debs ni/ dgra bgegs 'byung po'i spyi mgrin snying ga lte: gsang gnas gnam lcags tsakra rtsibs bzhi pa: gnam lcags rdo rjes mtshan dang tshigs chen bzhir: rgya gram lci zhing 'thas dang rigs sngags kyis: dmod pas mnan pas sgo gsum rmongs shing 'thibs: bsgyul bskyod smra bsam med pa nyid du gyur: ces dmigs gsal pos/ rtsa sngags gsham du/ oṃ āḥ.uṣ+ṇi ṣa: du na sa du na: e ka du na: she du nan: baṃ nir hūm̐ lam s+t+wam bha ya nan: zhes dmigs rtags dang ma ldan bar du bsgrubs/ (195) de ltar 'gugs bsad mnan gsum gyi thun mtshams kun tu dmar gtor bā la dang rak+tas bran par dmigs nas/ na mo rtsa brgyud bla ma sogs 'gug gzhug gi mthar sman raka bran la/ dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ngo bo rang bzhin rnam par dag cing rmad du byung ba las rnam pa dgra bo'i sha khrag gi rang bzhin yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs dang srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i dgyes skong dam par gyur:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ gsum gyis brlabs/ hūm̐: dgra bgegs gdug pa bdud kyi tshogs: sde dpu+ung 'khor dang bcas pa yi: sha khrag bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i tshogs (196)la 'bul: las dang bag chags dag pa dang : rang gshed bsam sbyor ngan pa rnams: kho rang la ni bzlog pa dang : rang mtshon rang la zug pa dang : rang sha rang gis za bar mdzod: rang sde rang gis phye mar thongs: rdul cha tsam yang med par mdzod: hūm̐: gtum chen 'bar ba khro bo'i rje: dpal chen rdo rje gro bo lod: rta mchog rol pa sras dang 'khor: 'jigs tshul rngams pa'i nga ro yis: dgra bgegs gnan nas 'gugs pa dang : bdag srung rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog: oṃ badz+ra kro ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes gtor ma 'bul/ de ltar thun gyi (197) dngos gzhi 'gugs gsad mnan gsu gyi rtags rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ las mtha' bsdu ba ni/ gzhung gi tshogs mchod bshags pa'i bar grub rjes/ rang nyid che mchog pad+ma drag po 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho rngams stobs ring zhing khros pas rmongs 'ching gi las mdzad par mos pa'i rgyal dang 'gugs bsad mnan gsum gyi sngags sbrel nas bzla bzhin du liṅga brub khung nas phyung ste mdun du bkod nas/ rang grib phar 'chor ba dang ling grib tshur mi go ba'i thabs kyang gzhung gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar byas nas/ thugs dam bskul zhing gzu dpang dang*/ 'gugs gzhug drag po lan gsum gyi mthar/ gu gul gyis bdug bh+yoḥ las byed phra men sogs dang*/ bsdu na/ dzñā na a yu she pra be sha ya phaṭa: ces brjod/ slob dpon gyis thun rdzas thogs pa brdeg cing (198) dmod mo bya ba ni/ ho: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo 'dis: sngags 'chang bdag la rgol ba dang : yi dam lha la phod btsugs pas: gzugs phung shig la tshe srog phrog: yas nas steng gi 'ju thag chod: 'og nas sa yi rten phur phyung : bar du rlung rta'i mkhar po shig:

drang srong dmod pa'i bka' chad phob: skye mched ma lus bgag tu chug: rten 'brel bcu gnyis bdud du phob: dug lnga'i rang mtshang kho nas shig: mi nor ma lus phyags mas thob: dus la bab po sa ma ya: zhes dang : hūm̐: dpal chen gsang ba'i bka' las (199) ni: zhes pa nas / badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ trig nan: zhes pa'i bar gzhung ltar brjod/ phur pa thogs la/ hūm̐: hūm̐ las byung ba'i sgrol ging ni: thung la sbom zhing gsus pa che: 'od zer bskal pa'i me dpung bzhin: dug gsum sreg byed kī la ya: he ru ka yi spyan snga ru: ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa: dkon mchog bla ma brnyas byed par: dus la bab po kī la ya: sku stod zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas pa ral gri nam mkhar 'phyar: g.yon pa thod pa khrag bkang gsol: dam nyams snying la kī la ya: (200)sku smad phur bu zur gsum dbal: blo ldan rdo rje tho ba yis: gnas bcu rnams su gdab par bya: oṃ gha ghā: ghā ta ya ghā ta ya: sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ phaṭa: kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ: hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: badz+ra kī la ya: badz+ra dha rod a dzñā pa ya ti: sarba bigha nan: kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta: badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes cha khrus kyi dgongs pas zan ling bsgral zhing mtshon chas gtub pa ni/ bsad gri thogs la/ hūm̐: sgrol byed ging chen bco brgyad po: bshan pa chen po srog gi gshed: rngams chen 'joms pa'i snying rje med: sha khrag drod la rgyug cing rngams: (201)las kyi sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed: kha rlangs nad kyi dbal du 'char: lag na mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams: gang la dmigs pa sngon du sgrol: tsit+ta dang ni nang khrol gtub: rnam shes bkrag mdangs lus srog dbral: sha khrag ro la sred cing za: kha gdangs lce bsgril mche ba gtsigs: rkang pas rgyug cing lag pas rtse: skye 'gro kun gyi srog dbugs len: kha nas khrag 'dzag myos shing brgyal: khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs:

ma lus srog gcod gzir zhing gnon: sdang (202)dgra gnod byed rdul du rlogs: bcol ba'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod: rings par khug la myur du sgrol: zhes dang*/ rtsa sngags mthar/ oṃ āḥ.uṣ+ṇi ṣa ya rbad: yan tra tsakra rbad: man+t+ra ya tsa ma rbad: bsad sngags btags pa bzla bzhin du ling ga gtubs la/ gtun du brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun: bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams: rdo rje me dbal snying bsreg nas: lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlogs: khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du: rdo rje tho bas brdung byas nas: lha yang rung ste brlag par 'gyur: kha thaṃ kha thaṃ: nyer gcig brjod/ (203) bstab pa ni gzhung ltar ram/ hūm̐: dbang drag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'chol ba'i khro rgyal zhal gdangs shig: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: zhal du bstab so kha raṃ khā hi: bcom ldan thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: dbang chen yab yum zhal phyes shig: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: zhal du bstab so kha raṃ khā hi: rigs bzhi'i ging chen mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgra bgegs sha ni bza' ba'i mchog: gti mug sha yi mchod pa bzhes: dgra bgegs khrag ni btung ba'i mchog: 'dod chags khrag gi (204)mchod pa bzhes: dgra bgegs rus pa bcud kyi mchog: zhe sdang rus pa'i mchod pa bzhes: dgra bo'i glo snying sman gyi rgyu: nga rgyal glo snying mchod pa 'bul: dgra bo'i mkhris pa dza gad rgyu: phrag dog mkhris pa'i mchod par bzhes: 'di ni dug lnga'i mchod pa ste: dbang drag lha tshogs bzhes su gsol: ma hā maṃ sa la khā ni: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: ma hā king ni ri ti la khā hi: zhes ling ro gtor mar bran zhing sman raka sgron/ de rjes lhag ma (205) khyer/ de nas mnan sngags bzla bzhin par ling ga la bsad sngags kyis ngar btags pa'i dug khrag gis khram btab pa la/

'dre'i lteb tshul mang yang g.yas kyis g.yon bkab/ sogs gsungs pa bzhin lteb nas shi skra dang tshon skud kyis rgya gram du bcings/ dmigs bsal gyi mnan thod 'byor na rab/ de min rang rang la rung mthun dang*/ rang gshed gnad dang ldan pa'i snod du gzhug thun rdzas dang*/ sri can la chad dang ba cha bul tog kyang brnan pas bar gseng med par bkang ste thal chen gyi ltam pa'am la chas bkag badz+ra karma ha na ha na badz+ra badz+ra: zhes rdo rje'i rgya rgyag 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i dgra dur phung gsum mnan pa khro bo'i dpung non gyi man ngag las gsungs pa/ hūm̐ e dzaḥbh+rūm̐: thugs rje'i 'od rtsal srid gsum gang ba'i (206)tshogs// gcig tu dril ba'i stobs shugs nus pa'i dbal// bgegs srin mthar byed gshin yul e gsang klong*// ting 'dzin rdo rje thod pa'i brda ru snang*// dbyings rtsal 'gog med bdud 'dul khro bo'i sprin// drag sngags lu gu rgyud kyi thig le yis// nam yang gzhom med rdo rje'i ngo bo ru// srid pa spu gri'i 'khor los rgyas thob cig /oṃ laṃ āḥlaṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+wam bha ya nan/ hā swā yeṇa ma shra hā ma/ dī ba waṃ e/ dha ro ni yo tse/ ṣāt+te/ da ba h+ya/ to ga thā ta ṣān/ te tun he wā bha pra tu he mā dh+ra ye oṃ/ zhes rten 'brel nag pos (207) rab tu gnas/ phung ras dang byad thag gis bcings la rtsang rgya gram du gzer te lag chags dam par bya'o// de nas skabs 'di'am long khyab dang bstun pa'i gang byang ba'i sa phyogs rung mthun dmigs bsal sogs kyi sa der bskyod la/ gser skyems dang dgos pa'i yo byad 'du byas nas/ sa bdag lto phye'i thig rtsa rang lugs phra zhib kyi lag len ltar ram/ yang na lta ba rgyas theb nges pa'i rnal 'byor pas chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig par thag chod pa'i mos pa brtan pos s+t+wa re 'jor sogs skor byed kyi lag char khro bo'i sngags kyis ngar btab pas dmigs dong chad sogs gsang sngags kyi gzhung chen po nas gsungs pa'i nges pa bzhin mdzad pa las/

bskyang 'khru 'dre skas btsugs pa lta bu'i sa dmigs 'tshal ba lung rigs gnyis kas dben te gsang chen gyi mig ltos la gnod pas dor na (208) legs so// de ltar legs par grub nas/ sgo dbye/ las gzhung gi bskul dang chad tho sogs spyi 'gros ltar byas nas/ gong mnon gyi gtor ma/ mnan chas/ mi kha'i rdzas thal 'dam sogs khyer nas mnan sar slebs pa dang*/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos theb phyogs dang mthun par 'dug ste gnas yul gzhi bdag lo zla zhag dus la dbang ba'i rigs la gser skyems bshams la/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud sogs kyis phul la bka' bsgo/ de nas sgrub rten gyi ral gri'am phur bu dong khar bsnun la/ tho chen dgra s+t+wa bsnun pas sa gzhi gas: mtha' yi rgya mtsho sngo mer gsal bar gyur: de dbus gnam lcags khang sa sgo med nang : las kyi gshin rje nag po ma he'i gdong : gting nas khros pa zhal (209)gdangs mche ba gtsigs: lag g.yas dbyug to g.yon pas sbrul zhags thogs: gcer bu rgyan med ma he'i steng na 'gying : gshin rje'i 'khor tshogs rngams pa'i tshul gyis bskor: mngon sum lta bur gsal ba nyid du gyur:

ces gsal gdab/ de nas bskul pa ni/ hūm̐: nyi ma lho phyogs pha ki na: rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas: srog la rngams pa'i gshin rje ni: nag po ma he'i gdan steng du: ya las byung ba'i dbyug pa ni: mi mgos mtshan pa las byung ba: gting nas khros pa ma he'i gdong : za byed (210)zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: khros pa'i spyan gsum dmar po 'khrug: skra ser sma ra gyen du brdzes: lag g.yon zhags pas dgra bgegs 'ching : lag g.yas dbyug tos rdul du rlogs: chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i tshogs: ma mo chen mo tsa mun+t+ri: bran dang bcas pa'i dus la babs: sha chen khrag zhag rgya mtsho yi: gachod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rgyal bas bsgos pa'i bka' bzhin du: snying rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: zung shig chings shig rnam par (211)sdoms: khug cig drongs shig dbang du sdus: sod cig sgrol cig rengs par gyis: phyes shig non cig rmugs par gyis: thul cig choms shig rnam par shig: rdul cha tsam yang med par gyis: bcol ba'i phrin las myur du sgrubs: dmar gtor sha khrag gis brgyan pa la / na mo: sogs 'gugs gzhug gang rung mthar/ oṃ e ra li hring hring dzaḥ brjod cing*/ dam rdzas mthun pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan pa 'jig pa'i dam nyams dgra bo dang : bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po pho mo rnams: lus ngag yid gsum ldang du med par (212)non: rig sngags drag pos grol ba med par chings: byas pa'i las dang nus mthu gtan nas sod: rtag tu thar pa med pa'i gnas su chug: ces dmar gtor dong nang du 'bul/ de nas mnan chas la dmigs te/ na mo rtsa brgyud bla ma sogs 'gugs gzhug drag po'i mthar/ hūm̐: sems can las ngan sdig can khyed: gtad do gshin rje'i lag tu gtad: bcing ngo rgya mtsho'i gting du bcings: mnan no ri rab 'og tu mnan: sbyong ngo 'byung ba bzhi la sbyangs:

sba'o klu rgyal snying la sba: 'di las 'das bar ma byed cig: bsdu na de tsam gyis kyang chog par sems/ (213)hūm̐ḥ dam nyams dgra bo las ngan khyed: khyod mdang sum mdang gi rmi lam na: rmi lam mi bzang rmi lam ngan: steng nas 'brug sgra ldir ba rmis: dung khang nang du nyal ba rmis: lus la 'ja' tshon gyon pa rmis: 'og tu rta sngon zhon pa rmis: bar na glog ltar 'khyug pa rmis: steng nas dung char babs pa rmis: gos nag lus la gyon pa rmis: snying la 'od zer phog pa rmis: lam rogs dmag mis byed pa rmis: hūm̐ḥ da nyon cig sdig can las ngan khyod: steng du 'brug sgra ldir ba ni: (214)sngags 'chang nga yi sngags sgra yin: bar snang glog ltar 'khyug pa ni: sngags lce glog ltar 'khyug pa yin: dung gi char ba 'char pa ni: yungs dkar thun gyis brab pa yin: dung khang nag du nyal ba ni: thod sgang skya mo'i nang du tshud pa yin: 'ja' tshon lus la gyon pa de: bal tshon sna lngas bsdams pa yin: 'og rta sngon po zhon pa de: 'gal ba'i rta la zhon pa yin: lus la gos nag gyon pa de: ro ras nag pos gtum pa yin: snying la 'od zer phog pa de: lha srung rdzu 'phrul phog pa yin: lam rogs dmag mis byed pa de: (215)nga yi bshan pa brgyugs pa yin: dam nyams dgra 'dre byur gsum khyod: khyod mnan rtags 'chi rtags thams cad shar: sdig can bya ba'i mnar med khyod: lus ngag yid gsum s+t+wam bha ya nan: zhes dang*/ sri can dkyus la/ hūm̐: skyes pa pho sri gang nas langs: pho sri gangs dkar steng nas langs: rdzu ba g.yag pho dkar por brdzu: g.yag pho rog po'i thod pa ru: gangs dkar steng du pho sri mnan: mnan no gzir ro ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: mo sri langs sa gang nas langs: mo sri rgya mtsho'i steng nas langs: rdzu ba khyi mo nag (216)mor brdzu: khyi mo nag mo'i thod pa ru: rgya mtsho'i gting du mo sri mnan: mnan no gzir ro ma ldang zhig:

hūm̐: chung sri langs sa gang nas langs: chung sri nyal sa'i 'og nas langs: rdzu ba khyi gu phrug gur brdzu: khyi gu phrug gu'i thod pa ru: chung sri nyal sa'i 'og tu mnan: mnan no gzir ro ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: dgra sri langs sa gang nas langs: dgra sri la rdzas 'og nas langs: rdzu ba spyang ki sngon por brdzu: spyang ki sngon po'i thod pa ru: dgra sri la rdzas 'og tu mnan: mnan no gzir ro ma ldang zhig: hūm̐: phung sri (217)god sri gang nas langs: phyugs sri ra ba'i dkyil nas langs: rdzu ba 'bri mo rog mor brdzu: sems can gang shi'i thod pa ru: phyugs sri ra ba'i dkyil du mnan: mnan no gzir ro ma ldang zhig: dgra bo 'phyo zhing smyo ru chug: dam nyams dgra bgegs byur gsum mnan: s+t+wam bha ya nan: zhes brjod cing liṅga mnan dong du kha phyogs ma 'chol bar bskyur/ ji bzhin bsdad na las 'grub bo/ dmigs bya khang chu gshin rje'i zhal bsdams te: mnan pa'i las sbyar dam nyams rū tra 'di: bskal pa ma stong bar du mi thar bas: mun nag rum gyi nang nas rgya (218)mtsho'i gting : rim bdun sa 'og gshin rje'i grong khyer song : zhes mi kha'i rjes rnams blugs/ dur g.yam la stong khams dang rgya gram bris pas bkab/ thal 'dam gyis lcibs la khro chus bsdams par bsams/ lo dang zla ba la dgra dar ba thams cad nan chings bru+ub: zhag dang za ma la dgra dar ba thams cad nan chings brub: srog lus dbang thang la dgra dar ba thams cad nan chings bru+ub: rlung rta dang sme ba la dgra dar ba thams cad nan chings bru+ub: khram la 'debs pa thams cad nan chings brub: mgo thog nas ri las lji ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: rkang 'og (219)nas tsher las rtsub pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: phyi dgra me ltar 'bar bar byed pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings bru+ub: nang dgra rlung ltar 'tshub par byed pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub:

rgyab nas 'ded pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: mdun nas bsgug pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: bzang dgra gong nas bsdigs pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: ngan dgra 'og nas 'jab pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: lus la sbrul ltar 'khril ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: klad (220)nas rbab ltar 'dril ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: zhabs su dngo ltar 'du ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: long ba brgya yi mi kha zug pa thams cad nan chings brub: ngan pa stong gi bra mchu zug pa thams cad nan chings brub: snga dgra lag gis brdar ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: phyi dgra yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: da dgra mdun nas bshams pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: mdun nas khyi ltar zug pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: logs nas (221)spyang ltar 'jab pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: gzugs can dgra bo'i dmag dpung thams cad nan chings brub: gzugs med lha 'dre'i za kha btod pa thams cad nan chings brub: gzugs med lha 'dre'i za kha btod pa thams cad nan chings brub: 'byung bzhi'i dgra dar ba thams cad nan chings brub: skyes pa pho brgya'i mda' gral du gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brub: za ma mo brgya'i 'phang ra na gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brub: byis pa chung gi rtse ra na gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brub: mgar ba'i sol kha du gleng ba'i mi kha (222)thams cad nan chings brub: mnyan pa'i gru tshugs su gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brub: mgron po kha dal gyis gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brub: dgra chags pa thams cad nan chings brub: bdud langs pa thams cad nan chings brub: sngags pa'i sgrub khang du gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brub: bon po'i g.yang gral du gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brub:

bla ma'i chos ra na gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brub: btsun pa'i tshogs gral du gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings (223)brub: bu mo'i bro ra na gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brub: gtso bo'i gros ra na gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brub: brgya kha mang gis gleng ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brub: stong mig mang gis blta ba'i mi kha thams cad nan chings brub: za dgos zer ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: 'phrog dgos zer ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: bcom dgos zer ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: brdung dgos zer ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: gsod dgos zer (224)ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: brku dgos zer ba'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: nye bas dgra shom byed pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: khyim mtshes kyis rku shom byed pa'i dgra bo thams cad nan chings brub: skyes pa pho'i pho sri langs pa thams cad nan chings brub: bud med kyi mo sri langs pa thams cad nan chings brub: byis pa'i chung sri langs pa thams cad nan chings brub: rgan po'i rgan sri langs pa thams cad nan chings brub: gzhon pa'i gzhon sri langs pa thams cad nan chings brub: dar (225)dar sri langs pa thams cad nan chings brub: phung sri god sri langs pa thams cad nan chings brub: bstan dgra'i lus ngag yid gsum s+t+wam bha ya nan: zhes thal brdeb bya zhing rnga mas brab/ me chu go ldog gi rgya dang sas cung zad g.yogs/ de'i steng du tshwa tshwa nag po gcig bzhag la sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i pho brang btab par bsam la/ ngag tu/ nam mkha' rlung me chu sa ri rab 'og: mnan pa yin gyi ldang bar ma byed cig: sangs rgyas don yod grub pas rgyas btab bo: dmigs med chos kyi dbyigs su sa ma dhi: zhes brjod pa/ sa rim sa bdun gyis g.yogs/ khod snyoms par byas la rta bro brdung ba ni/

sngags sdeb las/ mi (226)mthun glu sna blang ba ni// las mdzug bro yis bsdu ba yin// zhes gsungs pa bzhin mched lcam rnams mthe'u chung sbrel/ bro ra gru gsum du bcas la khro bo'i stangs stabs dang bcas te/ gcig ni brjod med nyag gcig rgya: gnyis ni thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum ni sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi ni phyag rgya bzhi yi rgya: lnga ni ye shes lnga yi rgya: drug ni pha rol phyin drug rgya: bdun ni ma mo bdun gyi rgya: brgyad ni dur khrod brgyad kyi rgya: dgu ni he ru ka klong dgu'i rgya: bcu ni khro rgyal bcu yi rgya: khyod la rgya bcu brtsegs te gdab: ri rab brjid pas steng nas mnan: (227)dpa' bo'i bro gar bcas te brdung : bskal pa ji snyed mtha' ru mnan: oṃ laṃ hūm̐ s+t+wam̐ bha ya nan: zhes bro brdung*/ de rjes gong non gtor ma/ dzaḥbh+yo rbadaḥ bh+yo: do nub drag po sngags kyis byin brlabs pa: sogs gzhung bzhin 'phangs/ brtan ma bskyangs/ spro na gtor gzhong mnan steng du kha sbubs la/ hūm̐ sum+bha na ི'i mthar/ hūm̐: e yi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: sogs brjod/ mthar mnan bya gnon byed thams cad gsal stong 'dzin med ngang la dar gcig mnyam par 'jog pa ni don dam pa'i mnan pa ste tshegs chung la don che ba (ni )zhig go /rgyud gzhan dang mkhas pa'i man ngag tu rang la phyir mi bzlog pa'i gnad 'gag gsungs pa'ang skabs 'di nyid du dran par bya: spyi chings las/ (228) dgra bgegs zhi ba'i rtags ldan na: bshags shing gso ba'i cho ga dang : tshe chog dag la 'bad par bya: zhes gsungs pa bzhin nang du log nas: tshe 'gugs gtang rag nongs bshags sogs bya ba yang gnad 'gag go /'dir smras pa/ rab 'bar 'jigs byed rdo rje drag po rtsal// rab tu khros pa 'chol ba'i khro rgyal gyi// rab 'byams las bzhi'i phrin la na kra'i grong*// rab yangs mtha' dbus gting mtha' med pa nas// mngon spyod dmod pa'i mtha' sdud rlung la bskur// bud shing bya dang rgya mtshor sba ba las// 'di ni phyi ma'i bzhed gzhung mnan pa'i khrigs// gab dkrugs dgos don snying por dril te bkod// deng dus bskyed rdzogs man ngag gzhung don las/

kham re'i zas las 'dam pa'i gnas skabs su/ 'di 'dra gdengs can mdun sar gla rtsi bzhin// phyogs lhung tshig gis zug rngus gnod (229) las ci// 'on te skal mnyam 'ga' yis bskul 'debs dang*// gter chos 'di la bdag gir byed pa'i slad// rma med lhag bsam dag pas nyer bsgrub la// nongs pa mchis na snying nas lha la bshags// gal te tshig shar klog pa tsam la yang*// ro 'dzin mdud pa'i rgyar chud skye bo yis// smros na kha twa'i mgo smras mgrin pa 'debs// de ni snying rje'i gzhi las do zla min// zhes mnan pa'i las khrigs ri rab nag po zhes bya ba wa gin+t+ra dharma kīrtī sogs don gnyer 'ga' dang rang la mkho phyir gzhung gi dgos don gtso bor bzung*/ khog dbus kyi man ngag 'ga' zhig gis zur brgyan/ 'gugs 'dren sogs kyi 'don cha byang bdag rig 'dzin dbang po'i sde'i ljags bsgrigs la skabs bab kyi bsgyur kha bag tsham re byas te zab chos 'di nyid kyi bka' (230) babs gter chen bla ma nges pa don gyi thams cad mkhyen pa lo chen bai ro gnyis pa rnga yab gling du gshegs nas bgrang bya rigs byed klu gzugs slebs pa 'dzin byed ces me pho byi ba'i dbo zla'i dkar phyogs kyi stong pa gnyis pa'i tshes la dmag dpon chu ltar 'khyog 'gros rtsom pa'i dus tshes rtsub mor rig pa 'dzin pa dbang chen mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis spel ba bstan dgra gzhom pa'i rgyur gyur cig ces kun mkhyen chen po 'jigs med gling pa'i rdo rje'i gsung la kha bsgyur te sbyar ba'ang dpal chen 'dus pas so// //////////////////////////////////////////
